recovery.title: Your recovery code
recovery.intro: If you forget your PIN, this code brings your account back.
recovery.body: Write it on paper and keep it at the shop. Do not give it to anyone.
recovery.warning: You will not see this code again.
recovery.helpBody: Look for the 12-character recovery code you wrote down at signup and contact support with it — we will restore access. Without the code, another owner or manager of the shop can add you as new staff.
